answer: We establish a mechanism utilizing a dynamic opportunity-cost bond deposited into a smart contract vault, combined with zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions to measure identity uniqueness. In this framework, a malicious partition of identity across a vast canyon of Sybil nodes triggers a subgame-perfect slashing penalty, rendering the expected utility of multiplication strictly negative. The system converges to a strict Nash equilibrium where the agent secures the digital garden rather than risk collateral forfeiture.
